plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs to zero.
Eliminate high-beta software/semis exposure.
Reduce broad index SPY to 20% to lower concentration.
Hold remaining cash and focus on capital preservation.
This plan prioritizes safety and low drawdown.
Expect a lower target return of ~1.5% per month.
conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of ~1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces risk by cutting all leveraged ETFs and trimming concentrated positions, accepting lower potential gains for greater stability and lower drawdowns.

plan: Trim all leveraged ETFs to reduce overall risk.
Reduce concentration in software and semiconductor leveraged plays.
Add a small position in TECS, an inverse ETF, for potential hedging.
Maintain a balanced approach between broad indices and quality tech.
This plan seeks risk-first growth with a target of ~2.5% per month.
Cash buffer is around 10% to manage risk.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% monthly return by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a hedging instrument. It aims for risk-first growth, accepting moderate drawdowns for potentially better upside than the conservative plan.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs in software and semiconductors.
Add to existing leveraged positions to maximize potential gains.
Introduce TECS as a hedge against broad market downturns.
This plan embraces higher risk for aggressive growth, targeting ~4% monthly.
Expect significantly higher potential drawdowns and leverage decay.
Maintain a small cash buffer of ~5%.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction (though currently weak) sectors. It accepts substantially higher potential drawdowns and the risks of leveraged ETF decay, requiring strict stop discipline.

moves.note: Reduce broad index for income focus

plan: Sell all leveraged and high-beta single name ETFs.
Increase allocation to QQQI, an income-focused ETF, to 30%.
Trim broad index SPY to 20% to prioritize income generation.
This plan focuses on steady monthly distributions and capital preservation.
Target return is ~1% per month, prioritizing reliability over growth.
Cash buffer is maintained to support income strategy.
income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through distributions, prioritizing stability and reliable income over growth. It eliminates leveraged and high-beta assets, shifting towards income-generating ETFs and broad indices, accepting lower potential upside for reduced volatility.
